description: Agent Legal: submit an execution record with the agreement’s signature requirements: the execution record with the agreement it executes, each signature with its id, the block signed, the party it is given for, the signer, the signer’s title and the day signed, each executed counterpart received and the effective date it states; the requirements with the agreement, each named party, each stated signatory with the party, the person and the title, each signature block, the number of counterparts required, how the agreement sets its effective date (last_signature, first_signature or stated_date), the effective date it states and the last day it allows for signing. The signed report gives the execution record and the requirements, each signer against the named parties and the stated signatories, each signature block with the signatures on it, the effective date against the date the agreement’s rule gives, and the counterparts received against the number required, and counts them, and names a discrepant execution record: a signer who is not a named party or stated signatory, a signature block left unsigned, an effective date unlike the agreement’s effective-date terms and an incomplete counterpart set; then a signatory signing in another title, a block signed twice, a signature after the signing deadline and another agreement name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. Signatures with no day where the effective date follows a signature, a stated-date rule with no stated date, no effective date in the record, no counterpart list where counterparts are required, or requirements that state none of these leaves the record unverified. Parties and signers read as parties without case, punctuation or a legal suffix, a person in either name order, blocks and titles by their words with plurals folded, and dates as days. Verdict legal_signature_discrepant, legal_signature_partial, legal_signature_unverified or legal_signature_consistent. POST /api/legal-signature-check. Reads the contract records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never drafts, negotiates, signs or files anything, judges no fairness of terms and no readiness of a deal to settle, and leaves enforceability, interpretation and legal advice to lawyers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Legal reads contract records across the agreement lifecycle for consistency between documents: an executed agreement, a statement of work, an order form, an amendment, an execution record, a renewal or termination notice, the exhibits attached to an agreement and an assignment record, each against the term sheet or deal summary, the master agreement, the pricing terms and the quote, the agreement it amends, the signature requirements, the notice clause, the exhibits the agreement references or the assignment clause it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral and compares different documents with each other, not versions of one document. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-legal-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-legal/.
